subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Miskitu Uhkara is a digital collection maintained by the Miskitu people of Nicaragua.
• Miskitu Uhkara means "our treasures" in the Miskitu language.
• It preserves images of traditional objects important to Miskitu cultural heritage.
• It contains a ceremonial drum (tukru pain in Miskitu) crafted from mahogany wood.
• It contains a fishing net (lihka watla) woven from plant fibers.
prompt: The student wants to specify the ceremonial drum's name in Miskitu. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The Miskitu Uhkara collection preserves traditional objects, such as a ceremonial drum and a fishing net, that are important to Miskitu cultural heritage.
choices.B: The mahogany ceremonial drum, which is contained in the Miskitu Uhkara digital collection, is called tukru pain in Miskitu.
choices.C: Miskitu Uhkara, which means "our treasures" in Miskitu, contains a ceremonial drum in its collection.
choices.D: The name of the digital collection Miskitu Uhkara means "our treasures" in the Miskitu language.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The sentence specifies the ceremonial drum's name in Miskitu, noting that it's called tukru pain.
